newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran warns U.S., Israel over aggressive moves.
newsitem.headline: Iran warns U.S., Israel over aggressive moves.

text.p: The commander of Iran's Revolutionary Guards has warned the United States and Israel against aggressive moves, saying Tehran would strongly retaliate throughout the Gulf, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

The daily Tehran Times quoted General Mohsen Rezaei as saying: "If...the slightest pressure is exerted on us, we will disregard all restrictions and become engaged in conflict with the U.S. throughout the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman, making them repent their deeds".

"He added that if Israel wants to take action against us, it will use its air force, and in response we will not restrict ourselves to the air. We will decide where and how to respond to Israel," the English-language daily said.

But Rezaei "ruled out the possibility of an all-out war in the region, saying that none of the regional countries are now ready for a big war. Given the economic, political and social situation in the region, the outbreak of such a war is unlikely", it added.
Rezaei's interview with the newspaper was held during a week of ceremonies in Iran marking the 16th anniversary of the outbreak of the 1980-88 war with Iraq.
He reiterated Iran's stand that Tehran is developing its military for defensive purposes and that U.S. interference was the main source of instability in the oil-rich Gulf.
The United States, which accuses Iran of sponsoring terrorism and has imposed sanctions on it, has repeatedly said that Tehran posed a threat to regional security.
Tehran has rejected all these charges and said Washington was trying to justify its military presence in the Gulf and sell more arms to Gulf Arab states by portraying Iran as a threat.
